chapter: Earl Hines, Chicago and later gigs
title: Leaving Tommy Miles for Earl Hines; Tyree Glenn and Eckstine
summary: Mundy went to Hines first and brought Young; Tyree Glenn replaced him in Miles's band, and Eckstine sang regularly only after.
